summary: Solid test suite with comprehensive coverage of core functionality. Strengths: Two-layer approach (unit tests + act integration tests) validates both module logic and CI/CD workflow; tests verify exact output values (e.g., AGGREGATE_STATS) rather than just presence; good error handling test coverage for file I/O and malformed input. Weaknesses: Some CLI parameters (-FailOnTestFailure, -OutputPath, -Path glob patterns) lack explicit isolated tests; assumes fixture directories exist without validating content; limited edge-case coverage (empty documents, special characters, very large counts); would catch most regressions in core aggregation logic but might miss CLI/UX failures.
